title: Warframe Task Checklist cycle data
$comment: all properties must be a task `id` in `tasks.json`

ref.description: reference time when the first cycle item began

columns.description: list of columns in the 'Show Schedule' dialog for this cycle. The currently active item from the FIRST column is also shown on the main task list.

nameKey.description: key for the column header, resolved against the `cycles` map in the locale files (en.js is canonical)

align.description: text-align CSS value to set for this column. When not specified, `order` items without `icon` behave as `center`, and as `left` with `icon`.

order.description: the order in which items are cyclically available. All `order` arrays under the same `columns` must be the same length.

textKey.description: key for the item text, resolved against the `cycles` map in the locale files (en.js is canonical)

icon.description: icon for the item, relative to `sources/img/icons/cycles`

cost.description: optional inline cost shown after the item (e.g. Teshin's Steel Essence price). A locale-invariant literal (number), so it is NOT keyed/translated like `textKey`.

costIcon.description: icon for the `cost` currency, relative to `sources/img/icons/cycles`

iconFilter.description: set to `true` to convert the `icon` to monochrome black or white depending on the theme. Otherwise, it will be used in color as-is. Note the opposite name and default bahaviour to `tasks.json`
